list: The official 55 PlayStation trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned.
sources_note: Names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags and PSN counts follow the official list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on every name, description and grade. Every guide below is written in my own words from the official description; where the official list does not pin down a place or step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: work the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the cleanup grind — and this one follows on its own. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it. It is the first story mission, so it cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are unmissable: keep playing the story in order and this pops at the chapter's end. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable — complete the chapter's story missions in order. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Unmissable: play the story through and it pops at the end of the chapter. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Unmissable: complete the chapter's story missions in order. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the gold story trophy: unmissable, it pops when the credits roll after the last mission. Do not worry about it until you get there — nothing before the finale gates it. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so it pops when you finish it during a normal playthrough — follow the mission objectives to the end. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the story path: finish it and the trophy pops. The official list does not say which chapter it falls in, so just play the story in order. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission and it pops. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission and it pops. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen. This is the long grind and the second gold: it counts story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the other tracked totals together, so it is really a summary of the whole roadmap — finish every other category first and check the stats screen for what is left. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like, as the game counts them. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so stunt naturally while driving and it builds up; for the last stretch, chain jumps off ramps and long drops. PSN tracks the target as 250. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 250).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one go at every kind of side activity the game offers (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest). You do not need to win or finish them all, just try each type once. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest activity trophy: visit the shooting ranges, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay any challenge until it is gold — progress is per challenge, so chip away at the ones you are closest on first. PSN tracks the target as 42 challenges. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 42).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Learn each course's corners once, then race to win — one win per location is enough, and you can retry a location as often as you like. PSN tracks the target as 14 locations. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 14).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race counts once, so work through the race list rather than replaying one favourite — vary vehicle classes and routes, and keep a note of which you have already won. PSN tracks the target as 20 races. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 20).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so take the challenge when Cal offers it and do not leave it for later — if the challenge is a one-off encounter, missing it may cost a replay. Fish steadily, watch the line tension, and land the bigger catch. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish at an arcade. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet, learn its controls in one practice run, then play it through to the end — completion, not a high score, is what counts. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and meet people — take Andy's missions whenever they appear and see the strand to its end. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Kenton's missions as they appear and complete the strand. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Billy's missions as they appear and complete the strand. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as icons on the map as you explore — stop for every one, finish each strand, and count them off: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five named ones, so you need three more beyond them. PSN tracks the target as 8 strands. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 8).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Tyrone's missions as they appear and complete the strand. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots are scattered around the map — visit each one and meditate there; the game tracks how many you have done, so work through them region by region and tick them off here as you go. PSN tracks the target as 18 spots. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 18).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a stranger-hunt task: meet Bret, take the hunt, track the animal and take it down cleanly. The official list does not name the animal or the hunting ground, so follow Bret's directions in-game rather than guessing. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida — pick them up as you explore, and trade or find the missing cards for each set; a set only counts when every card in it is collected. PSN tracks the target as 3 sets. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 3).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a long collectible grind: use the feature at every new spot you visit and the count builds up across the playthrough — do a dedicated sweep of the map at the end for the last locations. PSN tracks the target as 100 locations. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 100).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges are the game's small tracked goals across driving, combat and activities — they accumulate naturally, so check the challenges list often and chase the nearly-done ones first. PSN tracks the target as 50. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 50).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Do it deliberately: raise the heat together, then break line of sight, switch vehicles and hide until the stars clear — and do it while the partner is actually with you, or it will not count. Flagged missable because it needs the partner present, which is not always available. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the heat between robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving; if the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start again. Flagged missable because it needs the partner present. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Just drive or sit in new vehicles as you find them — every new model counts once, so try everything you see parked or driving past instead of sticking to one car. PSN tracks the target as 100 vehicles. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 100).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster: trigger Combat Focus with five targets in range and chain the takedowns before it ends — a busy shootout is the place, not a lone enemy. Flagged missable because it needs one clean five-kill window. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get a plane out of the airport without following the scheduled route: steal a plane on the runway and take off. Expect airport security and a wanted level, so go in with a fast vehicle and a clear runway in mind. Flagged missable because it is a one-off stunt at a specific place. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tanks. Get into a Rhino tank and survive the heat it brings: steal or commandeer one, then ride out the wanted level it attracts. Flagged missable because it needs a specific vehicle in a specific situation. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm, in and out before anyone notices. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy. Flagged missable because one detection ruins the run. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan each robbery with an escape route first — a fast car parked close by — then hit the vault, grab the cash and break away before the response closes in. Repeat for five vaults. PSN tracks the target as 5 vaults. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 5).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and get away before the police response arrives. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each area — drive, fly or sail through every region until the whole map is uncovered, and use the in-game map to spot the areas you have not visited yet. PSN tracks the target as 52 areas. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 52).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it and get out — you need all nine gangs covered, so keep a list and do not repeat a gang you have already done. PSN tracks the target as 9 gangs. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 9).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, easy to walk past. Flagged missable because it needs a specific place and action. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a showroom, get a fast car inside or lined up at the door, and go through it. Flagged missable because it needs a specific stunt at a specific place. trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that alley, start a game and follow through to the end — the trophy is about playing it, not scoring a strike. Flagged missable because it names one specific alley. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description points at a partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat with your partner that lands in front of a crowd. Play the story and it comes in its own time; the official list does not pin down the mission, so do not hunt for it — it is a story moment, not a grind. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500. This is a cumulative counter for decisions made across the game, so it builds up over a full playthrough; keep choosing, keep playing, and it pops when the count is reached. PSN tracks the target as 500 choices. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count: 500).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second try after failing it once. This is a one-off moment trophy: fail a specific attempt, then succeed on the immediate retry. Flagged missable because the setup is a failed first attempt followed by a successful second. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's odd, unexplained moment. The official list does not say where it happens, so this one is found by exploring Leonida's stranger corners rather than by following a mission marker. Flagged missable because it is a single unmarked event. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep the vehicle moving. Flagged missable because it needs one clean hit from a moving vehicle. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — pass them through your laundering contacts regularly instead of hoarding them, and the total builds up to $250,000 over the playthrough. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (trophy list).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. roadmap.title: Story playthrough — Chapters 1–4
roadmap.text: Play the story in order: Gone Fishing, the four chapter trophies, the named missions (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission. 12 trophies, all unmissable.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks — 8 strands
roadmap.text: Stop for every stranger icon: finish Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus three more strands, for the silver Strangers & Freaks and five bronze strand trophies.

roadmap.title: Activities & challenges
roadmap.text: Shooting Range golds (42), drone races (14), 20 race wins, 250 stunts, 50 challenges, 18 meditation spots, fishing vs Cal, one arcade game, bowling at Kolt & Associates, Bret's hunt.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.text: 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 spots, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas of Leonida, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & grind — missables first
roadmap.text: Do the 12 flagged missable trophies before the finale where they need a partner or a one-off moment, then the robberies (5 vaults, armored truck, 9 gangs), the money totals ($250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent) and 100% completion.

roadmap.title: Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
roadmap.text: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. Congratulations — you are a Leonida Legend.
